h1: Apartment interior design in Warsaw, 43 m² — contemporary minimalism

blocks.text: Apartment interior design in Warsaw, 43 m² — contemporary minimalism

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN developed a design project for a 43 m² apartment in Warsaw, Poland. The main goal was to create a contemporary, functional, and comfortable living space that makes efficient use of every square meter.

The interior is designed in a contemporary minimalist style. A light, neutral color scheme, understated forms, natural materials, and well-planned lighting create a visually spacious and harmonious environment. Particular attention was paid to balancing aesthetics, ergonomics, and practicality.

The layout includes a living area, kitchen, bedroom, workspace, bathroom, and functional storage systems. Each zone is organized around the residents’ everyday needs, ease of movement, and efficient use of the available floor area.

The project was developed as part of the “Basic” design package. We prepared the layout and interior solutions and selected finishing materials, lighting, and furniture to match the overall style of the apartment. The carefully planned placement of furniture and storage systems preserves a sense of open space even in compact rooms.

Photorealistic 3D visualizations were prepared to present the future interior, making it possible to evaluate the combination of materials, color schemes, furniture, and lighting before implementation begins.

This 43 m² apartment project in Warsaw showcases DUMSKAYA DESIGN’s approach to designing small living spaces where contemporary aesthetics are combined with functionality, ergonomics, and everyday comfort.
